chapter_length.notes: New or substantively updated chapters entering future release inventory must contain at least 2000 non-whitespace正文 characters. There is no maximum chapter length or preferred cap. Existing historical chapters are not retroactively blocked by this publishing gate unless they are being updated.

daily_word_floor.notes: Every normal release day is exactly five consecutive chapters at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai and must contain at least 10000 non-whitespace正文 characters. Partial release days and auto-continue scheduling are forbidden.

notes: Hard release invariant: each normal day publishes exactly five consecutive audited chapters at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai; every new or substantively updated chapter has at least 2000正文 characters and the day's total is at least 10000. There is no maximum chapter length. Future creates must use an explicit fixed start date. A fresh read-only reconcile is required before any strict reschedule so the expected pending chapter set is recorded and auditable.
